evidence_source: User-returned Aliyun stdout, 2026-09-10; not a new local checkpoint execution
duplicate_paste_note: The same run ID and table appeared twice in the user message; this is not evidence of two independent executions or seeds.
precision: Terminal-rounded values: index_L1/AbsRel/delta1/mean_abs_delta_q to 6 decimals, RMSE to 4 decimals. The full readout JSON and per-clip manifests were not supplied here.
verified_by_the_reported_runner: Saved fitted-pilot final metrics and valid-pixel count replayed within the predeclared tolerance before interventions.
Same model parameters/BN buffers and same per-group GT support across all raw-volume interventions.
Zero training steps; no optimizer or checkpoint updates.
Added training-pool clips have no fitted-frame overlap; exact scene IDs and temporal gaps remain in the full remote report.
limits: zero_raw removes signal magnitude and spatial/group means as well as depth variation; damage is not proof of correct geometric depth discrimination.
flat_depth_raw preserves each pixel/group's depth-mean of a geometrically constructed volume plus all image guides. It is not an RGB-only or geometry-free model.
Reversing depth improves AbsRel but worsens RMSE in unfitted_training_scene; do not call it an overall improvement or choose reversal as a fix.
These are fixed-weight inference interventions, not models retrained with flat or reversed volume inputs.
Two clips in an unfitted training scene do not establish cross-dataset zero-shot generalization or statistical significance; same-scene clips may be temporally adjacent.
The original pilot did not independently record a historical final-head file hash. Current-state checks and numerical replay are not an independent historical byte-identity attestation.
mean_abs_delta_q is computed on all output pixels, unlike GT-masked index_L1. It cannot be read as a matching accuracy or contribution percentage.
decision: Learnability and broad raw-input dependence confirmed for this pilot; stable benefit from correct depth-bin discrimination is not yet established. Stop repetitive readouts; next design is a matched TRAINED flat-depth control followed by the full-volume control, before attributing any gain to GRU. No further job launched in response to this record.
